g.title:
8. Contact Center Operations [Customer Care Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: The central customer service operations center powered by Avaya CCaaS (Aura / Oceana), supporting omnichannel agent desktop fleets, softphones, IVR self-service, WhatsApp Business integration, and regulatory call recording.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Resolves customer complaints, executes customer telephone balance inquiries, blocks compromised cards, assists with digital app onboarding, and logs dispute claims into K2 BPM and CRM.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Telco Aggregators (MTN/Airtel) via SIP over TLS (TCP 5061), WhatsApp Business Cloud API via Webhook (HTTPS 443), Website Live Chat via REST API • OUTBOUND: Finacle Read Replica & Databricks Customer 360 via CTI Screen-Pop, K2 BPM Dispute Management via REST API (Port 443), Call Recording Storage via Encrypted NFS/SMB • FAILOVER: Avaya Communication Manager clustered failover, multi-telco voice SIP trunking with automated overflow routing to backup voice circuits. • SECURITY: Dual-channel call recording with automated CVV pause/resume masking (PCI-DSS), encrypted softphone RTP audio, and role-based agent CTI permissions. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: 8. CONTACT CENTER OPERATIONS
AVAYA CC

g.title:
Avaya CCaaS Platform (Aura / Oceana) [Section 8: Call Center Operations] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Enterprise contact center suite combining Avaya Communication Manager, Session Manager, and Oceana Workspaces for omnichannel customer service.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Manages customer inbound telephone calls, IVR self-service banking (balance check, card hotlist), WhatsApp customer care chat, and automated outbound fraud confirmation calls.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: MTN & Airtel Voice PRI/SIP Trunks via SIP over TLS (Port 5061), WhatsApp Business Cloud API via Webhook HTTPS (Port 443) • OUTBOUND: Contact Center Agent Softphone Desktops via Encrypted WebRTC/RTP, Finacle Read Replica & Databricks Customer 360 for CTI Screen-Pop • FAILOVER: Avaya Aura clustered redundancy; multi-carrier voice SIP trunking with automated overflow. • SECURITY: Dual-channel audio recording with automated PCI-DSS CVV pause/resume, encrypted voice signaling, and supervisor quality monitoring. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Avaya CCaaS Platform (Aura / Oceana)
Enterprise Omnichannel Contact Center Solution:
• Avaya Communication Manager & Session Manager: High-density SIP cluster
• Avaya Oceana Workspaces: Unified agent desktop combining voice, email, chat, WhatsApp
• Interactive Voice Response (IVR): Self-service balance inquiry, card blocking, PIN reset
• Certified Vendor & Systems Integrator: Avaya Direct / Infinite Gold
AVAYA OCEANA
Contact Center Agent Desktop Fleet
Inbound Customer Service & Dispute Resolution Desks:
• Softphone client integrated via Computer Telephony Integration (CTI)
• Instant screen-pop with Customer 360 profile from Databricks / Finacle Read Replica
• Secure dispute logging into K2 BPM and CRM
• Agent headsets with active noise cancellation and encrypted audio
AGENT DESKTOPS
Social Media & WhatsApp Connector
Digital Customer Care Channels:
• Official WhatsApp Business API routing live agent escalations from bot
• Twitter / X, Instagram & Facebook Messenger sentiment analysis and direct care
• Webchat gateway embedded in Corporate Website and Internet Banking portal
WHATSAPP & SOCIAL
Call Recording & Speech Analytics
Regulatory Voice Archival & Quality Management:
• Verint / Avaya Contact Analyzer for 100% voice recording of inbound calls
• Dual-channel audio recording with PCI-DSS compliant automatic pause during CVV entry
• 7-year regulatory retention in encrypted WORM storage
• AI Speech-to-text sentiment analysis fed to Databricks for customer satisfaction scoring
VOICE RECORDING
